analysis: The trial failed source parsing before training: an empty ItemAttention declaration was followed by unresolved ======= markers and repeated class fragments, producing the reported indentation error. The host allocated 0 GPU-seconds and returned no validation score; model quality is unknown. Remove the malformed declarations and stray constructor assignments, retaining the complete ItemAttention class and its constructor.
code_summary: The intended architecture trains one independent candidate-conditioned attention network per category. Each uses shared 96-dimensional history/target item embeddings, learned key/query projections, candidate-specific attention with learned recency decay, normalized context–target similarity, and jointly learned item biases. Training uses sampled-negative cross-entropy and selects one checkpoint by validation HR@10, with NDCG@10 as a tie-breaker. The predictor writer routes each of the four datasets to exactly one matching checkpoint; no ensemble is implemented.
